claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC preflight certifies the exact rational coupling-background incidence family and its bundle/charge conventions. It proves that for nonzero electric field on the compact spatial circle, time translation has no continuous global connection lift, and that the equation-level duality reflection restoring spherical parity does not preserve the fixed-Chern tangent carrier. It therefore obstructs this family as the proposed stationary positive-frequency sign-comparison base and requires a combined mixed-parity carrier in any nonstationary continuation. It constructs no tangent cofiber, Lee-Wald current, inertia, sign wall, causal evolution, observable, particle or quantum state.

bundle_connection.electric_charge_policy: Q_e labels the background and is not topological; electric tangents are allowed unless a downstream fixed-Q_e carrier is separately declared
bundle_connection.fixed_bundle: P_N with N fixed and nonzero

geometry.field_strength: F=E dt wedge dx+P k_2^(-1) sin(theta) dtheta wedge dphi

parity_duality.equation_level_duality_remark: The source-free Maxwell equations and stress tensor admit the displayed SO(2) charge rotation, but it is not a local off-shell symmetry of the declared single-potential fixed-bundle action and it mixes allowed electric tangents into forbidden magnetic-Chern tangents.
parity_duality.pure_magnetic_limit: at tau=0 the combined involution is charge conjugation times spherical parity and the certified Phase-1 parity split may be recovered

stabilizer_lifts.H_obstruction: L_H A=E dx. For every single-valued infinitesimal U(1) parameter chi, integral_S1 dchi=0, whereas integral_S1 E dx=E L. Thus L_H A+dchi cannot vanish when E!=0.
stabilizer_lifts.finite_time_remark: A large gauge transformation can compensate only isolated time shifts satisfying q_min E L Delta_t in 2*pi*Z; this does not supply an infinitesimal H stabilizer.
stabilizer_lifts.pure_magnetic_endpoint: at tau=0, E=0 and H has the lift (partial_t,chi=0)
stabilizer_lifts.sphere_rotations: for i=x,y,z, use chi_i=-(i_{J_i}A_patch)-(P/k_2)n_i; since i_{J_i}F=(P/k_2)dn_i, L_{J_i}A+dchi_i=0 patchwise and the lifts respect the monopole transition
stabilizer_lifts.wilson_loop: W_x(t)=exp(i q_min E L t) times the time-independent flat-holonomy factor

exact_family.electric_charge_convention: Q_e=(1/(4*pi))*integral_S2 star F=E/k_2 for the declared orientation
exact_family.parameter_domain: tau=E/P is real; the oriented branch tau>=0 is used for the phase diagram; N is a fixed nonzero integer; q_min,kappa,L>0
